準備好迎接充滿謎題與魅力的海洋冒險吧。引導可愛的鯨魚穿越30個精心設計的關卡，在放鬆與策略之間找到平衡。推動小海龜到浮標上，幫助海洋恢復和諧，在這場可愛又平靜的邏輯冒險中暢遊。
探索三個寧靜的海洋世界：加勒比海、珊瑚礁與深海，每個世界都充滿溫馨的像素藝術與療癒的海洋氛圍。每一步都讓你更接近掌握溫柔思考的藝術，規劃路線、重新排列海龜，並以自己的節奏找到完美解答。
特色：
• 30個充滿可愛與巧思的手工關卡
• 三個溫馨海洋世界：加勒比海、珊瑚礁與深海
• 推動海龜到浮標上並重新排列以完成每一關
• 放鬆氛圍與迷人像素藝術，搭配柔和的海洋音效
深呼吸，規劃你的每一步，與海洋朋友一起掀起幸福的浪花。

column2: Lost in Heart of Chernobyl - Survival
column8:
在《Lost in Heart of Chernobyl - Survival》中踏上一段痛苦的旅程，這是一場扣人心弦的生存冒險，讓你陷入切爾諾貝利禁區的怪異深處。身為在切爾諾貝利核反應爐工作的工程師阿列克謝，你發現自己陷入了一場引發混亂和破壞的災難性事件。
曾經熙熙攘攘的反應爐現在變成了一片幽靈般的荒地，充滿了過去令人難以忘懷的遺跡。與外界隔絕，你必須穿越荒涼而危險的環境，搜尋廢棄的設施，冒著惡劣的天氣收集重要的資源。
但生存只是挑戰的一部分。該區域充滿了變異的恐怖和環境危害，考驗著你的智慧和意志力。當你探索搖搖欲墜的基礎設施時，你會發現令人毛骨悚然的故事片段，揭示災難背後的黑暗秘密。
每一步，你都會拼湊線索，揭開真正發生的事情的謎團。當你製作工具、建造臨時庇護所以及製定生存策略時，你的工程技能將受到考驗。您會揭開埋藏在切爾諾貝利中心的真相，還是潛伏在陰影中的危險太大？
潛入一個每一個決定都很重要、每時每刻都充滿危險的世界。迷失切爾諾貝利之心 - 生存挑戰你不僅要生存，還要面對黑暗並解開永遠改變的世界的謎團。

SAEKO：女巨人戀愛模擬 是以2000年代的日本為舞台的聲畫互動小說，講述一位擁有神奇能力的少女·冴子與被她縮為拇指大小的矮人們一同展開的奇妙生活。通過美術風格迥異的晝·夜兩種遊戲模式，冴子與矮人們的命運將被赤裸裸地呈現在你面前。

你將扮演剛剛得到冴子庇護的矮人·麟，與其他矮人一起在書桌的抽屜裡展開新生活。
但請提高警惕。冴子似乎……有些異於常人的癖好。

・區別明顯的兩種像素美術風格，兼具品質與創意。
・以笛地靜惠作品為靈感來源，受奇談小說影響，展現一個殘酷且極具魅惑力的世界。
・獨特的遊戲系統，將每個看似單純的選項變成攸關生死的抉擇。
・開發者親自打造，深受Future Garage與Breakcore薰陶的遊戲音樂。
・冠絕獨立遊戲史的開發者性癖濃度。

column2: The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure
column8: Following the events of Trails from Zero, the Special Support Section find themselves with new members and new duties. However, rising tensions in Crossbell along with pressure from two neighboring political powers threaten both the safety of their home, as well as the integrity of their team.

Originally developed by Digital Pictures and released in 1993, Double Switch has been completely rebuilt, bringing it to a level of video quality never before seen.

You control a state-of-the-art security system wired into the building where you take part in the many simultaneous sub-plots as you sleuth to solve the ultimate mystery. Should you capture or protect the mansion's weird and wild inhabitants and intruders?

Directed by Mary Lambert, Double Switch builds upon the gameplay of Night Trap as a spiritual sequel featuring higher production values and an all-star cast such as Corey Haim, R. Lee Ermey, Debbie Harry and Camille Cooper.

Experience Double Switch - 25th Anniversary Edition in a way that has never been experienced before with enhanced video quality and never before seen bonus content.

A hero isn't a hero at all without the right weapon... or a shop to buy one from! Become the man (sorry, potato) behind the heroes, forging amazing weapons and selling them on for tasty profits in Holy Potatoes! A Weapon Shop?!, a hilarious mash-up of management and simulation.

As a true chip off the old spud, take charge of your dad's weapon shop and turn it into the place to be for hard-boiled adventurers. Employ eager smiths to craft hundreds of weapons, then sell them to any heroic spud you like. Peel off the profits to buy more materials, find relics and enchantments on your travels, train up your smiths and then do it all over again! The better your weapons, the better your reputation becomes... keep it up and soon enough, you'll have a shop that really creams the competition!

Includes the bonus adventure - Spud Tales: Journey To Olympus - completely free, no hassle(back)!

• Dive into a hilarious potato world and take control of your own weapon shop, employing over 30 smiths to cook up the best weapons you can.

• Craft hundreds of unique weapons, training up your smiths to make better swords, axes and bows that'll bring in bigger wedges of cash.

• Explore the world for materials, relics and enchantments, then use them to research and build valuable weapon types.

• Features music by Kimura Masahiko, the legendary composer behind the scores for the Genso Suikoden and Castlevania series

Splasher is a 2D platformer with unique arcade-style action gameplay, set in a crazy cartoon universe. 

Stand up to Le Docteur – the paint factory's evil boss – and save the Splashers. Your prodigious paint cannon grants you colorful superpowers. Put your skills to the test and face whatever the factory throws your way.

FISTFUL OF INK
Use different colored paints to stick to walls and roofs, bounce high, and trick your foes.

MASTER CHALLENGING LEVELS
Brave the traps and beat the gigantic factory's security devices. Find the best path and get the best time in order to perfect the level. 

TIME ATTACK & SPEEDRUN
Challenge gamers worldwide with your best times, and share your scores on the leaderboards.
